versions.changelog:
xhs-guaikei-search 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides CLI tools for searching and analyzing XiaoHongShu (小红书) public data: notes search, note details, comments, and influencer posts.
- Supports four main scenarios: keyword search, single note details, comment analysis, and influencer post monitoring.
- Returns structured data for trend research, competitor analysis, KOL selection, and comment insights.
- Requires Node.js 16.14.0+ and GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Only supports public XiaoHongShu data; login, posting, or private content are not available.
